patterns.note: Sections frequently feature a prominent left-aligned heading or value proposition paired with supporting content or visuals on the right, creating a balanced yet dynamic horizontal flow.
The site heavily leverages oversized, bold numerical statistics to convey impact and results, making these figures a primary visual element in several key sections.

A clean, high-contrast palette of white and dark gray is consistently accented by a vibrant, deep blue for primary calls to action, links, and key visual elements, with a secondary bright green for specific CTA buttons.

The primary navigation bar transforms upon scroll, shrinking in height and gaining a subtle backdrop shadow as it becomes sticky at the top of the viewport, while an initial blue underline disappears.
Key content sections and large numerical statistics are revealed with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the user's viewport during scrolling.

The site uses full-width sections with alternating light and dark backgrounds to visually separate content blocks and provide rhythm, including a distinct dark section for 'Stord AI' with a video hero.

technique_notes: To rebuild the sticky navigation, implement a scroll listener that detects when the user scrolls past a certain point, then applies a CSS class to the header that reduces its height, removes its bottom border/underline, and adds a subtle box-shadow or backdrop blur for visual depth.

For scroll-triggered content reveals, use an intersection observer or a scroll-based animation library (like locomotive-scroll, as hinted) to detect when elements enter the viewport. Apply a CSS animation (e.g., a transform translateY combined with opacity) to make them fade and slide into place from below.

The video hero in the dark section would be implemented using a self-hosted video element or an embedded player, set to autoplay and loop, often with a muted audio track, to create an engaging background visual.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold headings (~3-4x body) with clear, readable body text, complemented by extremely oversized, semi-bold numbers for statistics (~5-6x body).
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (e.g., input fields, buttons, image corners).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and ample padding around content blocks, creating a clean and uncluttered feel.

standout: This site distinguishes itself through the impactful and authoritative use of oversized, bold numerical statistics as a primary visual and communicative element, immediately conveying tangible value and results rather than relying solely on descriptive text. The directness and clarity of these figures make the design highly persuasive.
